title: ResponderState: empty ZeroizeOnDrop does not generate Drop
description:
File: crates/oscore/src/edhoc/responder.rs
Line: 122
Category: memory-safety

## Description
Empty ZeroizeOnDrop impl does not generate Drop - PRK secrets (prk_2e, prk_3e2m, prk_4e3m) and transcript hashes persist in memory after ResponderState is dropped. Same issue as InitiatorState.

## Fix
Replace `impl ZeroizeOnDrop for ResponderState {}` with `impl Drop for ResponderState { fn drop(&mut self) { self.zeroize(); } }`
